sloka: तान् च सर्वान् हरि श्रेष्ठान् जांबवान् इदम् अब्रवीत् ।न खलु एतावत् एव आसीत् गमने मे पराक्रमः ॥४-६५-१४॥
transliteration: tān ca sarvān hari śreṣṭhān jāṁbavān idam abravīt ।na khalu etāvat eva āsīt gamane me parākramaḥ ॥4-65-14॥

translations.english: Jambavan, the distinguished among the monkeys again said, 'My strength to leap into the sky was not only that much (I was stronger in my youth and could cover longer distances)'
